consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the energy of the 1987-03-23 show at Hampton Roads Coliseum was exceptional, with many praising the band's tight performance and the enthusiastic crowd. Standout moments include powerful renditions of 'Stella Blue' and 'Touch of Grey,' which left a lasting impression on attendees.
